landing.hero.subheadline: Auth, payments, subscriptions, credits, RBAC, CMS, and i18n — all pre-wired. Just build your product on top.

landing.features.payment.title: Payments
landing.features.payment.description: Stripe, PayPal, Alipay, WeChat Pay — checkout, subscriptions, webhooks, and order management.
landing.features.rbac.title: Roles & Permissions
landing.features.rbac.description: Fine-grained RBAC with wildcard matching. Full admin panel for managing users, roles, and permissions.

landing.features.i18n.description: English and Chinese built-in with locale-aware routing. Easy to extend with additional languages.

landing.features.cms.description: Categories and posts with full CRUD, status management, and admin panel — build your blog or docs.
landing.features.credits.title: Credit System
landing.features.credits.description: FIFO consumption, expiration, auto-grant on signup, and revocation — ready for usage-based billing.

landing.faq.title: Frequently asked questions
landing.faq.description: Everything you need to know before getting started.
landing.faq.stack.question: What's the tech stack?
landing.faq.stack.answer: Next.js 16 with the App Router, React 19, TypeScript strict mode, Tailwind CSS 4, shadcn/ui, Drizzle ORM, and better-auth. Every piece of business logic is inlined — no external packages for payment, email, storage, or AI.
landing.faq.payment.question: Which payment providers are supported?
landing.faq.payment.answer: Stripe, PayPal, Creem, Alipay, and WeChat Pay out of the box. The PaymentManager abstraction makes it straightforward to add more providers by implementing a single interface.
landing.faq.database.question: Which databases can I use?
landing.faq.database.answer: Drizzle ORM handles PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite, Turso, and Cloudflare D1. Switch providers by editing DATABASE_PROVIDER in your .env — the schema templates and drizzle config adapt automatically.
landing.faq.customize.question: How customizable is the landing page?
landing.faq.customize.answer: The src/blocks/ directory ships with demo sections — they're designed to be rewritten per project. The durable primitives live in src/components/, so your rebrand touches blocks and translations, not the chassis.
landing.faq.license.question: Can I use this for commercial projects?
landing.faq.license.answer: Yes. ShipAny Next is built for shipping production SaaS products. You own the code after cloning — no per-seat fees, no runtime dependencies on our infrastructure.
landing.cta.headline: Ready to ship your SaaS?
landing.cta.subheadline: Stop wiring auth, payments, and RBAC from scratch. Start with ShipAny Next and build what actually makes your product unique.

radiant.about.title: More play. Less guesswork.
radiant.about.q1: What is this Radiant Optimizer site?
radiant.about.a1: An independent community directory inspired by the browser-game list shared by @RadiantOpti. It brings game links and practical gaming calculators together. It is not the official Radiant Optimizer Windows app.
radiant.about.q2: Can I play every game inside this site?
radiant.about.a2: Many games open in our embedded player. Some hosts block embedding, need their own tab, or are temporarily unavailable. Every game has a link to its original host. Some ports require your own game files.
radiant.about.q3: Do these tools change my PC settings?
radiant.about.a3: No. These calculators run in your browser and help you compare settings. They do not install software, change Windows settings, or promise an FPS boost.
radiant.about.q4: Where are my saved games stored?
radiant.about.a4: Bookmarks stay in this browser on this device. There is no account to create. Clearing site data will remove them. If browser storage is blocked, favorites last for the current session.

optimizer.feature.hardware.description: Follow CPU and RAM history, with GPU load, temperature and memory readings where the driver exposes them. Missing sensors are explained, never replaced with sample numbers.

optimizer.feature.process.description: See current process activity and memory use to understand what is running. This preview focuses on observation; closing apps and CPU affinity controls are planned separately.
optimizer.feature.network.title: Latency & DNS checks
optimizer.feature.network.description: Check endpoint round-trip time and DNS resolution with a visible target and method. Results describe that test, not a promise of in-game ping or a full bandwidth test.
optimizer.feature.input.title: Input & display tools
optimizer.feature.input.description: Try reaction timing, keyboard and mouse input, display colors, and supported controller input. Each tool explains what is measured and what your device exposes.
optimizer.features.title: Understand what your PC can do.
optimizer.features.description: Game presets, live hardware history, and frame capture now join the desktop toolkit. Support depends on the detected game format, Windows permissions, and available driver sensors.
optimizer.features.compatibility: Capabilities are checked on your PC. Unsupported controls remain unavailable.
optimizer.features.safety_title: Preview by default. An explicit choice to write.
optimizer.features.safety_description: System and game-file writes remain experimental. Enable them for the current desktop session, inspect the exact change, close the target game, and retain the recovery record. Game configuration is checked again before writing. Free detection, hardware sensors, previews and recovery do not require Premium.
optimizer.roadmap.title: The next chapters.
optimizer.roadmap.description: The following capabilities remain future work. They are not part of the working 0.2 Preview or a promise of a particular release date.
optimizer.roadmap.games.title: Wider game & application support
optimizer.roadmap.games.description: Additional game formats after compatibility checks, selected app closing, startup review, and process CPU affinity.
optimizer.roadmap.network.title: Deeper network diagnostics
optimizer.roadmap.network.description: Own test endpoints for upload and download measurements, latency under load, route checks, and verified adapter controls.
optimizer.roadmap.monitoring.title: Driver tuning & deeper diagnostics
optimizer.roadmap.monitoring.description: Verified NVIDIA driver controls, bounded storage tests, and GPU memory stress diagnostics. Current GPU support reads sensors only.
optimizer.faq.performance.a: No. Presets make supported graphics changes, and monitoring helps you compare your own results. Performance depends on hardware, drivers, the game, and starting settings. We do not promise an FPS increase or display an invented health score.
optimizer.faq.browser.q: Can the website optimize my Windows PC?
optimizer.faq.browser.a: Windows inspection and settings run in the native desktop app. The website handles product information, accounts, purchases, and device activation. The browser calculators work locally but do not change Windows settings.
optimizer.faq.recovery.q: Can I return to the previous setting?
optimizer.faq.recovery.a: Supported Windows changes save original values. Game changes preserve the original file bytes before writing. The recovery center checks for external changes and remains free. These records do not replace a full system backup.
optimizer.faq.premium.a: In 0.2 Preview, Premium adds applying supported game presets, existing power-plan switching, FPS recording, the separate overlay and frame CSV export. Detection, game previews, hardware sensors with CSV export and recovery remain free. One license supports one active device.

optimizer.pricing.premium.scope: Game formats and sensors are checked locally. FPS capture requires available frame events and Windows permissions. The overlay supports windowed or borderless use; NVIDIA driver tuning and universal game compatibility are not included.

optimizer.pricing.faq.devices.q: Can I move my license to another PC?
optimizer.pricing.faq.devices.a: Yes. Each license allows one active device. Unbind the current device from your account, then approve the code from your new installation. The previous device can no longer refresh its license.
optimizer.pricing.faq.offline.a: The desktop app refreshes a signed lease while online. That lease lasts up to 7 days. Refunds, revocations, or unbinding stop future refreshes; an already-issued offline lease may remain usable until it expires. Diagnostics and restoring existing changes stay available.
optimizer.pricing.faq.future.q: Am I buying the features on the roadmap?
optimizer.pricing.faq.future.a: Evaluate the purchase against the current scope: supported game preset application, existing power-plan switching and frame capture with local overlay/export. Future game formats, driver tuning, bandwidth tests and application controls are not part of 0.2 Preview.

optimizer.admin.revoke_description: This prevents new activations and stops the bound device from refreshing its license. An existing offline lease may remain valid until expiry, at most 7 days. This does not issue a payment refund.
optimizer.activate.title: Connect your desktop app.
optimizer.activate.description: Start in the Windows app, then confirm its short-lived code here. Your website password and session are never passed to the desktop app.
optimizer.activate.sign_in_title: Sign in to confirm your device
optimizer.activate.sign_in_description: Use the account that owns your Premium license. We will bring you back here with the device code after you sign in.
optimizer.activate.code_description: Enter the code shown in your desktop app. Codes expire after 5 minutes. Check the device name before approving access.
optimizer.activate.code_required: Enter the code from your desktop app.
optimizer.activate.code_invalid: Enter a valid device code using letters, digits, and an optional hyphen.
optimizer.activate.device_error: The code is invalid or expired. Start a new request in the desktop app.
optimizer.activate.no_license: No unbound active license is available. If you already own a license, unbind its current device before activating another one.
optimizer.activate.confirm_note: Approve only if this is your device and you initiated the request. This uses the license's single device slot.
optimizer.activate.success_description: Return to the Windows app to finish activation. Keep the app open while it retrieves its device credential.
optimizer.activate.security_note: This page confirms a device request only. It never asks you to paste a website session token or share your password. Free diagnostics and restoring existing changes do not need activation.
optimizer.error.session: Your session has expired. Sign in again to continue.
optimizer.error.device_bound: This license is already bound. Unbind the current device in your account before trying again.
optimizer.error.license_unavailable: This license is no longer available. Refresh your licenses and choose an active one.
optimizer.error.rate_limit: Too many attempts. Please wait a moment before trying again.
optimizer.error.request_failed: The request could not be completed. Please try again; if it continues, contact support from your account.
optimizer.feature.games.title: Game presets, preview first
optimizer.feature.games.description: Discover CS2, Fortnite and VALORANT configuration files. For recognized formats, inspect a preset, save the original bytes, and apply supported graphics settings. Unknown formats and running games block changes.
optimizer.feature.monitoring.title: FPS & frame-time capture
optimizer.feature.monitoring.description: Choose a running process and record real frame events with PresentMon. Review FPS, frame-time P95/P99 and 1% low, use a separate floating overlay, and export the session as a local CSV.
optimizer.faq.games.q: Which games can I configure automatically?
optimizer.faq.games.a: The app recognizes narrow CS2, Fortnite and VALORANT file versions listed in the support table, with competitive and balanced presets. Unknown or missing versions, missing required keys and running games block writes. Files are backed up before changes. Actual game-launch compatibility still needs validation against your game version; the browser-game directory is separate.
optimizer.faq.capture.q: Does the overlay work in every game?
optimizer.faq.capture.a: It is a separate topmost window for windowed or borderless play. Exclusive fullscreen may hide it. PresentMon needs Windows event access and frames from the selected process. These FPS readings describe application presentation cadence, including dropped frames, rather than physical-display FPS. Missing access or samples is shown explicitly.
optimizer.pricing.premium.games: Supported CS2, Fortnite and VALORANT preset application (experimental)
optimizer.pricing.premium.capture: PresentMon FPS recording, floating overlay, and frame CSV export
optimizer.download.requirement4: GPU temperature and memory readings depend on a compatible NVIDIA driver. Windows GPU counters provide a fallback where available; CPU temperature is not included.
optimizer.download.requirement5: FPS recording uses the included PresentMon tool and Windows event tracing. Required permissions and missing samples are explained in the app. The separate overlay is intended for windowed or borderless play.
optimizer.support.title: Check what your setup exposes.
optimizer.support.description: Support means a recognized file or available sensor, not every version of a game or GPU. The client explains unsupported formats, permissions and missing readings.
optimizer.support.games.title: Game configuration support
optimizer.support.games.cs2.scope: Competitive or balanced preset for existing VSync and MSAA keys. Resolution, controls and other content stay unchanged.
optimizer.support.games.fortnite.scope: Competitive or balanced preset for frame cap, VSync and existing supported quality keys. Input, account fields and resolution stay unchanged.
optimizer.support.games.valorant.scope: Competitive or balanced preset for recognized Riot frame limits and existing material/detail quality keys. Sensitivity and controls stay unchanged.
optimizer.support.games.note: These are narrowly supported preview formats, not compatibility claims for every live game build. Discovery searches known local locations; a file can also be selected. Missing or unknown versions, missing required keys, running games, read-only paths and changed content block application. Preview shows the full path and changes; original bytes are backed up before writing. Actual launch behavior still requires validation against the target game version.
optimizer.support.monitoring.title: Monitoring sources and limits
optimizer.support.monitoring.system.name: CPU / RAM
optimizer.support.monitoring.system.scop: Live usage history. CPU temperature is not provided by this preview.
optimizer.support.monitoring.nvidia.name: NVIDIA GPU
optimizer.support.monitoring.nvidia.sour: NVML from the installed NVIDIA driver
optimizer.support.monitoring.nvidia.scop: GPU load, temperature and memory where the driver exposes them. Some consumer cards or driver modes omit individual readings.
optimizer.support.monitoring.other.name: Other / fallback GPU readings
optimizer.support.monitoring.other.scope: Available GPU activity and memory readings. A fallback does not add temperature support; unavailable values show a reason.
optimizer.support.monitoring.frames.name: FPS / frame times
optimizer.support.monitoring.frames.scop: Selected process and launch identity, 5–300 second capture, and Windows event permissions. FPS, P95/P99 frame times and 1% low describe application presentation cadence, including dropped frames; they are not physical-display FPS or input latency.
optimizer.support.monitoring.note: The overlay is an independent window for windowed or borderless use; exclusive fullscreen can cover it. Sessions are bounded and cancellable. CSV files and local capture data are not automatically uploaded. No samples, failed sensors and stale readings are shown explicitly; this website does not read live PC data.
